title: 🖐️ Retro Player / Generated Hand Atlas

current_candidate.summary: V7 replaces mismatched Wikimedia SVG hand swaps with a user-directed generated 10x10 photographic hand atlas. IDLE, GRAB, INSPECT, PUSH and WEIRD consume coherent atlas rows while preserving persistent scene consequences.

open_feedback: Review V7 in the real published Player and judge whether the generated hand finally reads as one actor rather than unrelated poses.
Tune frame cadence, foreground scale and screen compositing if the atlas feels too flickery, too large or leaves visible dark cell rectangles.
Keep every future atlas frame fully inside its source cell with safe margins; no fingertip or wrist may be baked off by a grid edge.
Use designed/generated coherent hand families for future actions instead of unrelated clipart/icon assets.
